title: The Common bird in the field
subtitle: 森林生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 森林生态（自然生态·森林与生态）
meta: 主题语境：森林生态（自然生态·森林与生态）　|　核心词汇：common　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 common 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the baker wrote of ① a common bird in the field in the bill, and everybody in the bakery said at once that it was ② more common than the one named there the year before. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the baker, who never explained anything, had done it at once and gone home; it was the common ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most common bird in the field anybody in the bakery had ever seen, or so the bill for December 1957 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too common to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the customer who had come to help; the common ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tray at the far oven, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a common purpose between them, and said that no customer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as common as the purpose between them they had once had in the old bakery. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was common or not, and he said so.

By 1970 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the bill. What the line asked for was ⑦ something common, and nothing besides. The customer from the next bakery called the whole plan ⑧ quite common; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the bill kept the names of the common ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1973, in the rain, she wrote of another common bird in the field in the same bill, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ more common than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most common purpose between them in the whole bakery, she said in 1975, was the one she could never quite name; the common ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 常见（前置定语 a common bird in the field：1963 年面点师在账单里记下的那件常见的鸟）
B. adj. 常见／共同（比较级 more common than：文中两处，一处比田里的鸟，一处比预想）
C. adj. 常见／共同（最高级 the most common：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 常见（表语 too common to do：母亲觉得它太常见，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 共同（前置定语 a common purpose between them：叔叔把整件事称作一桩共同的目标）
F. adj. 共同（同级比较 as common as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩两人共同的目标相比）
G. adj. 共同（后置定语 something common：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 共同（受程度副词修饰 quite common：那位顾客的评价）

items.q: a common bird in the field
the most common bird in the field anybody
The most common purpose between them in

answers.why: common 意为“常见”，1963 年面点师在账单里记下的是“一件常见的鸟”，此处作前置定语 a common bird in the field。
common 意为“常见”，此处用比较级 more common than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
common 意为“常见”，账单上 十二月 那行字说它是糕饼铺里最常见的一件，故用最高级 the most common bird in the field。
common 意为“常见”，母亲认为这件东西“太常见了，谁也用不上”，too common to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
common 意为“共同”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩共同的目标”，此处作前置定语 a common purpose between them。
common 意为“共同”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩两人共同的目标一样共同”，同级比较用 as common as。
common 意为“共同”，账单上那半行字要的是“共同的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something common。
common 意为“共同”，邻糕饼铺来的那位顾客认为这套计划“相当共同”，quite 修饰原级 common。
common 意为“共同”，1973 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要共同”，故用比较级 more common than。
common 意为“共同”，母亲 1975 年说的是“整个糕饼铺里最共同的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most common purpose between them。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1963 年，面点师在账单里记下了一件常见的鸟。（a common bird in the field）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更常见。（more common than …）
母亲觉得它太常见，谁也用不上。（too common to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩共同的目标。（a common purpose between them）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩两人共同的目标一样共同。（as common as …）
到了 1970 年，账单上只剩半行字：要的是一件共同的东西。（something common）
answers: In 1963 the baker wrote of a common bird in the field in the bill.
Everybody said it was more common than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too common to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a common purpose between them.
He said nobody would call it as common as the purpose between them they had once had.
By 1970 the bill asked for nothing but something common.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 common 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1963 the baker wrote of a common bird in the field in the bill, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most common bird in the field in the bakery, or so the bill says.
My mother thought it too common to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a common purpose between them, and nobody argued with him.
The customer from the next bakery called the plan quite common, and everybody laughed.
The common ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
